runtime_input_policy.copyright_rule: Rebuild a new scene; never copy the reference coffee, latte art, exact grout intersections, exact shadow silhouette or pixel layout.

allowed_style_features: strict overhead view with slight perspective
large circular matte white table entering from the right
narrow gray tiled-floor wedge on the left with receding grout
one complete product just below center
broad environmental shadows from unseen room elements
plain white ceramic handled mug only when container adoption is selected
forbidden_copy_features: reference coffee color, crema or latte art

pov_modes: strict overhead with slight real perspective
micro_moments: the drink has just been set on the table
room air and window shadows continue outside the crop

tone_contract.background_plane: large matte warm-neutral white circular tabletop with a narrow cool-gray tiled-floor wedge at left
tone_contract.color_bias: warm-neutral white with neutral-to-faintly-cool gray floor and shadows, never beige
tone_contract.highlight_behavior: soft shoulder with visible table, rim, floor and product detail and no clipped broad white area

composition.camera_angle: strict overhead with slight real-world perspective
composition.camera_height: high above the table with the floor visible beyond its edge
composition.horizon_visibility: none; depth comes from the curved raised table edge and receding floor grout
composition.depth_of_field: product, table edge and nearby floor remain readable with only gentle finite-distance falloff
composition.alignment: right-dominant circular table, narrow left floor wedge and one product just below center

lighting.type: one large diffused natural window partially interrupted by off-frame room elements
lighting.shadow: one attached product shadow plus broad irregular soft-edged environmental shadows that imply objects outside the frame
lighting.highlight_control: retain white-table texture, floor tonal separation, rim thickness, ice and beverage color without clipping

color.saturation: low globally with source-authoritative product color

scene.surface: plain matte warm-neutral white circular tabletop
scene.background: narrow gray tiled cafe floor visible along the left of the raised table edge
scene.texture: subtle matte table and tile variation with no fabric weave or decorative pattern

capture.look: natural Instagram cafe overhead photograph with quiet but dimensional framing
capture.realism: one physical exposure, normal optics, attached shadows, visible floor perspective and finite social-photo acuity
capture.grain: faint luminance grain after ordinary social compression
imperfections: natural beverage, ice and garnish asymmetry

editable: container only when adopt_reference is selected
reference_exclusions: do not copy the reference coffee or latte art
do not copy exact grout or shadow silhouettes
do not copy or invent text

prompt_blocks.input_roles: The full user image is analyzed for beverage identity and container family. Image 1 submitted to generation is an automatic beverage-surface evidence crop; source camera pose, background and sidewall perspective are discarded. The approved reference remains offline and supplies the white round-table overhead scene and, in adopt mode, the plain handled-mug design.
prompt_blocks.composition: Use a strict overhead view with slight perspective. Let a large circular matte white table dominate the right side; retain a narrow left wedge of gray tile floor with receding grout. Keep one complete product just below center.
prompt_blocks.look: Use one broad upper-left window source, warm-neutral whites, neutral gray floor and soft but spatial off-frame environmental shadows across both planes.
prompt_blocks.preservation: Preserve the user beverage's top-surface color, opacity, ice, foam, fruit and garnish while regenerating the complete product under the target overhead camera. In source-family mode keep only the broad cup family and material, not exact sidewall geometry or branding. In adopt mode use the plain opaque white handled mug and keep all beverage color strictly inside its inner rim.
prompt_blocks.negative: No fabric, coaster, napkin, saucer, props, visible furniture, flat seamless white background, copied latte art, crisp graphic shadow, pasted edge, fake text, logo or watermark.

quality_gates.logo_text: do not tilt the overhead camera to reveal source sidewall branding; omit branding when it is not naturally visible, and keep the adopted reference mug plain unless a separate target brand contract authorizes otherwise
quality_gates.product_identity: beverage, serving temperature, ice, layers, toppings and recognizable color remain source-authoritative
quality_gates.preset_adherence: overhead camera, right circular table, left receding tiled floor, product scale and broad off-frame shadows meet the numeric contract
quality_gates.artifact_policy: reject pasted edges, detached shadows, clipped whites, malformed vessel geometry, copied latte art, fabric or generic AI flat-lay reading

failure_recovery: restore the curved table edge and narrow left floor wedge
restore receding grout and table-to-floor height separation
add broad low-density off-frame environmental shadows without copying the anchor silhouette
remove all fabric, coaster, napkin, saucer and props
restore source-authoritative drink identity and serving details
